Author: Sett
Name: Vendor Runner
Description: Persistent currency lists, right-click item adding, native commands, mounted-flight vendor navigation and verified one-shot purchases. Beast Tribe / Allied Society vendors are excluded, including their gil shops. Development build; live testing required.
Punchline: One-shot gil-vendor shopping with permanent lists and automation status.

Author: wah
Name: wahventory (Refresh Fork)
Description:
An inventory management plugin
• Smart safety filters
• Market price integration via Universalis
• Bulk discard functionality
• Category grouping and search
• Gearset protection
• /wahventory refresh command (MagicalMontra fork)
• Refresh/discard completion reporting
• Inventory right-click discard and blacklist submenu
• Market price filters and quality-specific pricing methods
Punchline: Advanced inventory management with safety filters and auto-discard
Changelog: Price filters now show matching per-item prices: < 500 shows prices below 500 gil; > 1000 shows prices above 1,000 gil. Both enabled use either match. Unknown prices do not match; controls still wait for refresh completion.
